rows.description: City Commission item 7: allocates $30,000 from the Public Art Fund toward design and installation of two murals, "Feature Wall 1" and "Paseo Mural" by Sonny Behan, at Modera Coral Springs (Cornerstone). Outcome not verified.
rows.needs_review: Names a private individual (artist Sonny Behan); publish the name as described?

rows.description: BOCC B-2: amended and restated Arena Renovation Improvements Agreement with Lightning Hockey LP and Tampa Bay Arena, LLC, plus lease, sublease and guaranty amendments; largest figure in item $250,000,000 (13.4% of general fund). Outcome not verified.
rows.needs_review: Item text is cut off; $250,000,000 is the largest figure in it, not a confirmed county commitment. Publish as described?

rows.description: Lake Wales City Commission workshop: considers Capital Improvement Revenue Note, Series 2026B, principal not to exceed $7,052,000, to finance various capital improvements including real property and improvements for public parking, plus transaction costs (25.5% of general fund). Outcome not verified.

Dunedin City Commission: after-the-fact ratification of emergency PO increases to CrowderGulf Joint Ventures, Inc. ($1,233,200) and Tetra Tech, Inc. ($211,420), $1,444,620 total, for grant-funded ditch channel clearing (7.84% of Dunedin's special revenue funds). Outcome not verified.

Delray Beach City Commission: Resolution 91-26 authorizing a special event sponsorship of up to $8,000 for the Muscle on the Beach Car Show, to be held March 6, 2027 (under 0.01% of general fund). Outcome not verified.
rows.shortfall: Nov 12 (Florida Today): Delray Beach loss from Amendment 3 estimated at $21M; Commissioner Casale puts it closer to $11M.

rows.description: City Council: Ord 2026-0100-E appropriates $4,165,172 within the General Fund to remove negative budget amounts and partially fund a previously authorized completion grant for the Gateway Jax development (0.24% of general fund). Result: Pass per clerk.
rows.shortfall: Nov 9 (Jacksonville Today): CAO Mike Weinstein: $150M to almost $200M less next budget; $300M by FY2028-29.

rows.description: Council: awards ITB #2025-25 to Hycon Investments, lowest bidder, to renovate the Government Center third floor into a new City Council Members area, $432,388.32 plus 10% contingency, up to $475,627 (0.42% of general fund). Outcome not verified.

BCC: Economic Development Hotel Incentive Grant Program award for Hotel Siena Holdings LLC under Section 7-5 of the county code, with the Chairman to sign the agreement once finalized. Amount not stated. Outcome not verified.

Commission C7 O: agreements with FDOT for locally funded work in the State Road 907/Alton Road reconstruction (Michigan Ave to 43rd St), incl. a shared-use path by the golf course; largest figure in item $21,217,695 (4.8% of general fund). Outcome not verified.
rows.shortfall: Nov 17 (Miami Herald): Commissioner David Suarez: "We're going to have to start making serious cuts"; city expects to lose about $11.9M in FY2028, $22.5M in FY2029.

rows.description: City Commission: increase to the annual General Stormwater Infrastructure construction continuing contract with various contractors, $10,420,219 (2.2% of general fund). Result: Pass per clerk.

BCC: awards IFB Y25-1002-MV, tree trimming for Roads and Drainage, to low bidders Q Pavers & Concrete LLC ($9,793,525) and Rapid Response Force LLC ($12,666,112.15), five-year terms, $22,459,637 total (1.5% of general fund). Result: Pass per clerk.

City Commission: Amendment No. 4 to Contract 2428 with Barton Malow Builders LLC, Phase II guaranteed maximum price for the Jackie Robinson Ballpark renovation, up to $10,160,956 (6.8% of general fund). Minutes list it adopted (Res. 2025-469).

County Commission: Ninth Amendment to the P25 System and Services Master Agreement with Motorola Solutions, Inc., raising not-to-exceed amounts by $10,661,000 for the regional public safety radio system (0.55% of general fund). Outcome not verified.

BCC: award of IFB Y25-1037-LS, Hauling Transfer Trailers, to low bidder Blew Bayou Services LLC, estimated $8,200,000 for a five-year term (Utilities Department, Solid Waste Management Division). Result: Pass per clerk.

City Council 12.2: allocates $857.75 from Mayor Rodney Harris' Community Benefit Account to sponsor food and refreshments for the Diaspora Arts Coalition's 2025 Kwanzaa celebration held Dec. 26, 2025, approved nunc pro tunc. Outcome not verified.

CRA Board 7.01: Commercial Property Improvement Program grant of $33,714 for exterior and interior improvements at 1330 Lake Bradford Road (0.10% of Tallahassee's special revenue funds). Minutes show the motion passed unanimously.
rows.shortfall: Tallahassee Commissioner Williams-Cox (Nov 13): "significant budget challenges"; Leon County / Tallahassee Amendment 3 impact $71,000,000.

rows.description: City Council: Reso 2026-0037-A approves an economic development agreement with Proj Underground to support expansion of an existing manufacturing facility in Jacksonville; 5-year REV grant not to exceed $275,000. Result: Pass per clerk.
rows.shortfall: Jacksonville CAO Mike Weinstein (Nov 9): $150M to almost $200M less next budget; $300M by FY2028-29.

rows.description: BCC: agreement with WSB LLC for construction engineering and inspection (CEI) services for the County Road 557 widening project, not to exceed $7,671,349.67 one-time. Result: Pass per clerk.

Finance Committee amendment: increases appropriation to $9,400,000 ($4,400,000 Braddock Rd. & Dunn Ave. intersection; $5,000,000 Pecan Park Rd. widening); waives Sec. 655.505 to allow over 20% of a Mobility Zone's fees for intersection work. Outcome not verified.
rows.shortfall: Jacksonville CAO Mike Weinstein (Nov 9): $150M to almost $200M less next budget; $300M by FY2028-29.

rows.description: County Commission: fixed contract to low bidder Ranger Construction Industries, Inc. for Taxiway A Pavement Rehabilitation Phase II at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (Bid PNC2130571C1), Aviation Department, $17,892,543 incl. $1,233,500 allowance. Outcome not verified.
